verses.sanskrit:
जरितोवाच।
              अस्माद्बिलान्निष्पतितमाखुं श्येनो जहार तम्। क्षुद्रं पद्भ्यां गृहीत्वा च यातो नात्र भयं हि वः॥१॥
verses.english: Jarita said: The little mouse that came out of this hole was seized by a hawk with its claws and it has been carried away. Therefore, you may enter it without any fear.

verses.sanskrit:
शार्ङ्गका ऊचुः।
              न हृतं तं वयं विद्मः श्येनेनाखुं कथंचन। अन्येऽपि भितारोऽत्र तेभ्योऽपि भमेव नः॥२॥
verses.english: The Sharangakas said : We are not at all certain whether that mouse has been carried away by the hawk. There may be other mice living there. We have every fear from them.

verses.sanskrit: संशयो वह्निरागच्छेद्दृष्टं वायोर्निवर्तनम्। मृत्युर्नो बिलवासिभ्यो बिले स्यान्नात्र संशयः॥३॥
verses.english: There is every chance that the fire will not reach us in this place, for it may be carried away in some other direction by the wind. There is no doubt, however, that if we enter the hole, we shall be killed by the dwellers of the hole.

verses.sanskrit: निःसंशयात्संशयितो मृत्युर्मातर्विशिष्यते। चर खे त्वं यथान्यायं पुत्रानाप्स्यसि शोभनान्॥४॥
verses.english: If we remain where we are, death is uncertain. O mother, a position in which death is uncertain is better than one in which it is certain. Therefore, it is your duty to escape, for if you live, you may have other children as good as ourselves.
verses.bhavadeepa: वह्निरागच्छेदित्यत्र संशयः यतो वायोः सकाशाद्वह्नेर्निवर्तनं दृष्टम् ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: जरितोवाच। अहं वेगेन तं यान्तमद्राक्षं पततां वरम्। बिलादाखुं समादाय श्येनं पुत्रा महाबलम्॥५॥
verses.english: Jarita said : O children, I myself saw the great hawk, that best of birds, swoop down with great speed and fly away with the mouse from the hole. I quickly followed the bird and I pronounced blessings upon him for his carrying away the mouse from the hole,

verses.sanskrit: तं पतन्तं महावेगा त्वरिता पृष्ठतोऽन्वगाम्। आशिषोऽस्य प्रयुञ्जाना हरतो मूषिकं बिलात्॥६॥
यो नो द्वेष्टारमादाय श्येनराज प्रधावसि। भव त्वं दिवमास्थाय निरमित्रो हिरण्मयः॥७॥
verses.english: “O king of hawks, as you are flying away with our enemy, the mouse, in your claws, may you live in heaven with a golden body and having not a single foe.

verses.sanskrit: स यदा भक्षितस्तेन श्येनेनाखुः पतत्रिणा। तदाहं तमनुज्ञाप्य प्रत्युपायां पुनर्गृहम्॥८॥
verses.english: When the hawk devoured the mouse, I then obtained his leave and returned to this place. O children, enter this hole with all confidence, you have nothing to fear. I myself has seen the mouse carried away by the illustrious hawk.
verses.bhavadeepa: दिवम् आस्थाय निरमित्रः अशत्रुर्भव अक्षयः स्वर्गस्तेस्त्विति भावः । हिरण्मयः दिव्यदेहः ॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रविशध्वं बिलं पुत्रा विश्रब्धा नास्ति वो भयम्। श्येनेन मम पश्यन्त्या हृत आखुर्महात्मना॥९॥

शार्ङ्गका ऊचुः।
              न विद्महे हृतं मातः श्येनैनाखुं कथंचन। अविज्ञाय न शक्यामः प्रवेष्टुं विवरं भुवः॥१०॥
verses.english: The Sharangakas said : O mother, we do know whether the mouse has been really carried away by the hawk. We cannot enter the hole in the grounds without knowing it.

verses.sanskrit: जरितोवाच। अहं तमभिजानामि हृतं श्येनेन मूषिकम्। नास्ति वोत्र भयं पुत्राः क्रियतां वचनं मम॥११॥
verses.english: The Jarita said : I know to a certainty that the mouse has been carried away by the hawk. Therefore, O children, you have nothing to fear. Do what I say.

verses.sanskrit:
शार्ङ्गका ऊचुः।
              न त्वं मिथ्योपचारेण मोक्षयेथा भयाद्धि नः। समाकुलेषु ज्ञानेषु न बुद्धिकृतमेव तत्॥१२॥
verses.english: The Sharangakas said : C mother, .ve do not mean that you are trying to dispel our fears with a false story. When a person's reason is confused, his acts cannot be called his deliberate acts.

verses.sanskrit: न चोपकृतमस्माभिर्न चास्मान्वेत्थ ये वयम्। पीड्यमाना बिभर्ष्यस्मान्का सती के वयं तव॥१३॥
verses.english: You have in no way been benefited by us; you do not know who we are. Why do you then try to save us to so much cost to yourself? Who are we to you?
verses.bhavadeepa: न त्वमिति । अस्मांस्त्यक्त्वा गन्तुमिच्छन्त्यास्तव मिथ्यैवायमुपचारो न वास्तव इति भावः । समाकुलेषु सन्दिग्धेषु । ज्ञानेषु ज्ञातव्यकार्येषु । तत् बिलप्रवेशनम् । वुद्धिकृतं बुद्धिमदाचरितं नैव । बिले शत्रुसद्भावशङ्कायां सत्यां बलात्तत्र प्रवेशो न युक्तः इति भावः ॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: तरुणी दर्शीयाऽसि समर्था भर्तुरेषणे। अनुगच्छ पतिं मातः पुत्रानाप्स्यसि शोमनान्॥१४॥
verses.english: You are young and handsome you are able to search for your husband. O mother, go to your husband and you will obtain excellent sons again.
verses.bhavadeepa: न चेति । अस्मान् अग्रे वा उपकर्तॄन् भूतभाव्युपकारशून्यान् किमिति बिभर्षि । वयं तव के न केपीत्यर्थः । त्वं वासती अस्माकं का न कापि । मातृसंबन्धस्य भ्रान्तिकल्पितत्वादित्यर्थः ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: वयमग्निं समाविश्य लोकानाप्स्याम शोभनान्। अथास्मान्न दहेदग्निरायास्त्वं पुनरेव नः॥१५॥
verses.english: Let us obtain the higher regions by entering the fire. If the fire does not consume us, you can then come back and obtain us.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्ता ततः शार्ङ्गी पुत्रानुत्सृज्य खाण्डवे। जगाम त्वरिता देशं क्षेममग्नेरनामयम्॥१६॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by them, the female bird (Jarita) left them (her sons) in the Khandava; with great speed she went to the place where there was no fire and where there was safety.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तीक्ष्णार्चिरभ्यागात्त्वरितो हव्यवाहनः। यत्र शार्ङ्गा बभूवुस्ते मन्दपालस्य पुत्रकाः॥१७॥
verses.english: Then Agni in haste and with fearful flames came to the spot where the sons of Mandapala were.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तं ज्वलितं दृष्ट्वा ज्वलनं ते विहङ्गमाः। जरितारिस्ततो वाक्यं श्रावयामास पावकम्॥१८॥
verses.english: The (young) birds saw the blazing fire coming towards them. Then Jaritari spoke these wards in the hearing of Agni.
verses.bhavadeepa: तत इति । अग्निदाहात्प्रागेव तक्षकवज्जरितापि गताऽतो दाहात् षडेवमुक्ता इति पूर्वोक्तमविरुद्धम् ॥१७॥
